title: Cochlear implant surgery
what: The surgeon places a device under the skin behind the ear and a thin electrode in the inner ear. On the outside, you wear a processor that sends sounds.
why: For severe hearing loss, when hearing aids do not help.
duration: surgery usually takes 2 to 3 hours; the hospital stay is usually a few days; the implant is switched on a few weeks later
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you had problems with anesthesia
For a child: all vaccines, especially against pneumococcus. The doctor will tell you

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Hearing tests, a CT or MRI, and blood tests. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Vaccines
prepare.text: Before surgery, you usually need the vaccines your doctor prescribes.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: The clinic will tell you when to stop eating before anesthesia.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Bring clothes that do not go on over your head.

steps: An IV line is placed in your vein
The anesthesiologist puts you under general anesthesia
The surgeon makes a cut behind the ear
The implant is placed, and the electrode is put into the inner ear
The wound is stitched, and a bandage is put on
feel: After anesthesia, you may feel sleepy and sometimes sick
Pain behind the ear. You will get pain medicine
Dizziness or ringing in the ear may happen in the first few days
after: Stitches are removed or dissolve. The surgeon will tell you
The processor is switched on and tuned a few weeks later
Sessions with a hearing and speech therapist are very important for the result
Before any MRI, always say you have an implant
red_flags: A fever over 38°C, or pus or swelling behind the ear
A severe headache, vomiting, or a stiff neck: call emergency services

faq.a: Sounds appear after the processor is switched on. Understanding speech is learned gradually.

faq.q: Can you swim with an implant?
faq.a: The inside part is not affected by water. The processor is taken off or a waterproof cover is used.

reminders.text: Cochlear implant surgery tomorrow. Bring your documents and things. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
